offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures equipment for paper, packaging, recycling, and other industrial process industries, including stock preparation systems, fluid handling, and doctoring and cleaning products. Sells to paper mills, recyclers, and makers of wood products, plastics, and other materials, plus aftermarket parts and services.

primary_products.value: stock preparation equipment; paper machine accessories (doctoring, cleaning, filtration); fluid handling systems (rotary joints, syphons); balers and recycling equipment; wood processing and cutting equipment

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts supply; equipment servicing and maintenance; equipment rebuilds and upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: paper and packaging mills, recyclers, waste haulers, wood products, plastics, rubber, food and battery manufacturers

end_markets.value: paper and packaging; recycling and waste; wood products; plastics and rubber; electric vehicle batteries

revenue_model.value: product sales: capital equipment and engineered systems; product sales: recurring replacement parts and consumables; service fees: equipment servicing, rebuilds and upgrades
revenue_model.category: product sales; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds equipment from purchased materials and components, sold to mills, recyclers and industrial manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, China and other Asia, South America

specialization.value: related lines: stock preparation, fluid handling, doctoring and cleaning, balers, wood processing equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales and service staff selling to mills and industrial customers; distributors / dealers: agents and distributors in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal industrial product safety, environmental and trade rules apply
